headline: Approved agreement with AKRF, Inc. for Hamden Center traffic signal improvements on Dixwell Ave, and referred it to full Council.
summary: Chair Osmanu said he is planning a symposium, tentatively for December, on economic development. It would give residents a chance to share their vision for economic development and its role in addressing the Town's fiscal challenges.
decisions: Approved agreement with AKRF, Inc. for Hamden Center traffic signal improvements on Dixwell Ave, 6-0.
Referred the AKRF, Inc. agreement for Hamden Center traffic signals to the full Council, 6-0.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
ENGINEERING, 
DEVELOPMENT & MUNICIPAL 
PLANNING COMMITTEE 
 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Ted Stevens 
Committee Members: 
Present - Sean Cardwell 
Present -  Grace Teodosio 
Absent - Rhonda Cardwell 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Present - Doug Foley 
Absent - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Absent - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
 Present - Katie Kiely, President 
 
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Engineering, Development & Municipal Planning Committee, October 19, 2026 – 7:00pm.  
Vice Chair Stevens called the meeting to order at 7:31pm with the members noted above 
in attendance.    
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No members of the public came forward to make public comment.  Public Input was 
closed at 7:33pm.  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Vice Chair Stevens noted the upcoming Boards/Commission meetings that fall under the 
Public Works Committee.  Chair Osmanu mentioned he was in the early stages of 
planning a symposium, tentatively anticipated for December, with Economic Development 
Director Fontana, Engineering Director White and Town Planner Lipschitz to provide 
residents with an opportunity to share their vision for economic development and its role in 
addressing the Town’s fiscal challenges.  
  
4. REGULAR AGENDA  
  1. ORDER APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO SIGN AN AGREEMENT 
WITH AKRF, INC. - HAMDEN CENTER TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS-PHASE 2 
ROUTE 10 (DIXWELL AVE) 
Motion to open: Council member Foley; Second: Council member Stevens 
Vote: 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item passed unanimously.   
President Kiely invited the Committee to refer the item to the full Council for vote this evening.   
Vice Chair Stevens called for the vote: 
Vote: 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Vote to refer the item to the full Council was 
unanimous. 
  
5. NEW COMMITTEE BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting. 
  
6. UNFINISHED COMMITTEE BUSINESS 
There was no unfinished business for this evening’s meeting.  
7 .      ADJOURN 
       Chair Stevens adjourned the meeting at 7:51pm.
